ref: #2 §3: ifWithoutElse passes its then input where the condition is true; its else value is a function parameter, and the empty-string else value is skipped while the SUPPRESS one keeps its slot and the queues in step [SAP✓ https://help.sap.com/saphelp_nwpi711/helpdata/en/5d/db0e83e8e74202a5bff527055ab7e5/content.htm] [SAP✓ https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_NETWEAVER_750/0b9668e854374d8fa3fc8ec327ff3693/4bf416d9eaca4c86e10000000a42189e.html]; assumed reading of #78: a context function whose box parameter keepSuppressValues (PO's "Keep SUPPRESS Values", label and default [COMM]) is false by default, so a false condition leaves no slot, and true gives SUPPRESS at the slot; only the exact text true is true (#77); obs-ifwithoutelse (#35) and obs-boolean decide it. The inputs pair as a Lift's do (ADR-0006): context i with context i, an empty or missing context gives an empty one, the longer input sets the slot count and the shorter reuses its last value
note: removeContexts(ifWithoutElse(Qty in context Order, Tag)) with keepSuppressValues=true onto Item; V is Sku in context Line. o1: Tag z, no Line; o2: Line (a, false), no Tag; o3: Tags x, y, Lines (b, true), (c, false). The empty contexts of o1 and o2 give no slot, not SUPPRESS, so the queue is x, SUPPRESS and its one Item reads the first Line context, a. Were they SUPPRESS, the Item would be at slot 3 and read c.
